en.headline: Hong Kong GDP expands 4.3 per cent in second quarter
en.dek: Advance estimates show the economy grew for a 14th consecutive quarter, driven by strong merchandise exports, though seasonally adjusted growth slipped 0.6 per cent from the first quarter.
body: Hong Kong’s economy expanded 4.3 per cent year on year in real terms in the second quarter of 2026, according to advance estimates released by the government on Friday. The figure follows 5.9 per cent growth in the first quarter and marks the 14th consecutive quarter of expansion.

On a seasonally adjusted quarter-to-quarter basis, real GDP decreased by 0.6 per cent. Private consumption expenditure rose 2.9 per cent, government consumption 0.5 per cent and gross domestic fixed capital formation 4.6 per cent. Total exports of goods accelerated to 28.8 per cent growth, while imports of goods increased 29.3 per cent. Exports of services rose 3.4 per cent and imports of services 2.8 per cent.

A government spokesman said the economy continued to expand robustly, underpinned by buoyant external trade and resilient domestic demand. Looking ahead, solid growth is expected in the second half, supported by global demand for artificial-intelligence-related products, sustained visitor arrivals and steady demand for financial and business services, alongside firm domestic demand.

External headwinds including geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, uncertainties over US monetary policy and trade protectionist measures among major economies still warrant close monitoring. Revised figures and the updated full-year GDP forecast will be released on 14 August.

zh.headline: 本港第二季本地生產總值按年升4.3%
zh.dek: 政府公布初步估計，第二季經濟連續第14季擴張，貨品出口表現強勁，惟經季節性調整後按季下跌0.6%。
body: 政府星期五公布本地生產總值初步估計，2026年第二季按年實質增長4.3%，上季度則升5.9%，連續第14個季度錄得增長。
按季節性調整計算，第二季實質本地生產總值較上一季下跌0.6%。私人消費開支升2.9%，政府消費開支升0.5%，本地固定資本形成總額升4.6%。貨品出口總額升幅加快至28.8%，貨品進口升29.3%；服務輸出升3.4%，服務輸入升2.8%。
政府發言人表示，第二季經濟繼續強勁擴張，受惠於對外貿易暢旺及本地需求具韌性。展望下半年，預料全球對人工智能相關產品需求暢旺、訪港旅客持續增長，以及金融和商業服務需求穩健，加上本地需求堅穩，經濟將繼續錄得穩健增長。
發言人同時指出，中東地緣政治緊張、美國貨幣政策不確定性，以及主要發達經濟體貿易保護措施等外圍風險仍需密切留意。第二季修訂數字及全年預測將於8月14日公布。
